```{r}

# Construct combined plots

                 "Green small-medium connected (s*d)",
                 "Green medium-large connected (s*d)",
                 "Green large connected (s*d)")

p = plot.patches.points.ES(ds_patches_effect_size %>% filter(day > resource_flow_days[1]),
                       patch_type_i[grep("connected", patch_type_i)],
                       paste0(response_variable, "_d"))
```

p
